result:
Each plan on the Plans page now has an **Archive** checkbox, and the cancelled finish-time work is gone: it never got past reading the code, so nothing needed undoing. All eight test suites I ran pass on copies, including a copy of your real data, and I clicked through the feature in a real browser. Your real database's fingerprint stayed the same, and nothing is committed.

**How it works**
- **Ticking:** the plan moves to an **Archived** section at the bottom of the page and stops being active. If it was the active plan, Home shows the prompt to create a plan, even if you have other plans. It doesn't switch to one of them by itself.
- **Unticking:** the plan returns to the normal list and doesn't become active by itself. The test confirmed its runs were identical afterwards, including moved dates, notes and done marks.
- **While archived:** you can open its summary and delete it. It can't be made active, including by going directly to the address. The summary page has an "Archived" label and no action buttons.

**Decisions to check**
- **No Edit on archived plans:** you didn't mention this directly, but editing regenerates a plan's runs, which would break "runs unchanged". To edit one, untick it first.
- **Deleting the active plan:** the app falls back to your newest remaining plan, and it now skips archived ones. If only archived plans remain, Home shows the create-a-plan prompt.
- **Running history:** archived plans still count, since you asked me not to change anything else.
- **Open runs:** a run's own page in an archived plan still works if you have its address, and its done box can still be ticked. Nothing in the app links there, so I left it.

**After a restart:** existing accounts and plans keep working. The app adds one new column to your database at startup and marks every existing plan as not archived. I tested that upgrade on a copy of your data, and your plans and pages opened normally. The real database hasn't been upgraded yet, and will be when you restart the app.

Hard-refresh once (Cmd+Shift+R) to load the new styles. The login and signup pages are unchanged.
